title: Helm upgrade sequencer: prevent on-prem operator timeouts and post-upgrade config drift
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Summary: A recently upgraded on-prem customer cluster experienced a failed Helm upgrade that left the operator and related CRs in a partially-applied state. This manifested as a leader-election bounce and multiple Helm hook timeouts, which in turn created an opaque configmap/state skew that blocked subsequent automated reconciliations. Impact: production inference degraded for the customer (elevated 5xxs during rollout), support escalated to SEV and requested an immediate mitigation and long-term hardening. Root causes identified so far: (1) concurrent operator leader re-election during helm post-upgrade hooks causing reconcile restarts, (2) Helm hook timeout values too aggressive for noisy customer clusters causing partial resource creation, (3) no coordinated upgrade lock across nodeagents/helm-controller leading to interleaved changes and a race that leaves CR status inconsistent. Goals: (a) shipping an emergency mitigation that detects and completes stuck post-upgrade hooks automatically or performs safe rollback, (b) add a sequencer/upgrade-lock in the operator to gate helm-controlled changes so only one upgrade path is active per cluster, (c) increase Helm hook & probe timeouts and add idempotent preflight checks to detect CR schema skew, (d) provide a customer-facing runbook and an automated remediation job that support can trigger. Acceptance criteria: (1) reproduce failure in testbed and verify sequencer prevents CR status drift, (2) automated remediation clears stuck hooks without manual config edits, (3) release passes e2e on a 300-node noisy cluster, (4) support runbook validated with oncall and documented links to dashboards and rollback steps.
comments: 2026-03-09: Ticket opened after SEV call with customer ACME Corp. Initial triage by oncall (Marco) identifies Helm hook timeouts in logs and operator leader churn.
2026-03-09: Captured core dump and helm release history; recreated a failing upgrade flow in staging that matches customer timing (noisy background pods + slow kube-apiserver).

2026-03-10: Root-cause hypothesis formed: race between nodeagent post-upgrade init and operator reconcile loop. Decided to prototype an upgrade sequencer (cluster-scoped Lease-based lock) in operator.
2026-03-11: Prototype implemented in feature branch 'sequencer/ENG-94567'. Basic lock acquired before helm pre-upgrade and released after post-upgrade reconciliation. Unit tests added.
2026-03-11: PR feedback from @Tara-Li: ensure timeouts are configurable via CR and defaults are conservative for onprem; add metrics for lock acquisition latency and held-duration.

2026-03-12: Added an automated remediation job 'helm-hook-completer' that scans for HelmHook resources in failed state and attempts idempotent completion or orchestrated rollback. Running in canary namespace in staging.

2026-03-12: Support runbook draft created and reviewed with SRE. Includes 'detect-stuck-hooks' kubectl one-liners, remediation job trigger, and safe-rollback checklist. Customer notified of temporary mitigation (manual remediation performed) and ETA for release.

2026-03-13: Integration test failing intermittently under synthetic network jitter; increasing hook timeout from 30s to 120s in test profile and adding exponential backoff to leader-election attempts.
2026-03-13: Next steps assigned: (1) finish e2e on noisy 300-node cluster, (2) add Prometheus alerts for lock contention > 2m, (3) prepare patch release and customer communication template.
